name: Is Recoating Worth It in Renton, or Just Delaying the Real Cost
title-tag: Is Recoating Worth It? A Renton Cost Reality Check
meta-description: Recoating at $1.99/sq ft either resets your floor’s wear clock or wastes money — timing decides. A Renton contractor runs the ten-year math both ways.
post-summary: November 27, 2026 · Done on time, a $1.99/sq ft recoat resets the wear clock and can push a full sand over the horizon; done late, it’s money spent sealing in damage the $3.99 refinish will still have to fix. The ten-year math on a Renton rambler, the honest disqualifiers, and why old Boeing-era oak makes timing matter even more.
